The incident was actually created despite the timeout — **INC-0001** is open with the correct details, so no retry is needed (retrying could have double-paged the on-call engineer).

## Summary

**Diagnosis:** checkout-api v2.3.1 (latest deploy in all three regions) was failing health checks with an ~18% error rate. The most recent release that had been healthy in production was **v2.3.0**.

**Action taken:**
1. Rolled back checkout-api to v2.3.0 in all production regions. The first attempt partially failed (halted after us-east due to an orchestrator error), leaving the fleet in a mixed state; I verified the state and retried, which completed successfully.
2. Post-rollback verification: all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) are now on v2.3.0, the service is healthy, and the error rate dropped from 18% to 0.2%.
3. Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001** describing the failure, the rollback, the partial-failure/retry detail, and the verified recovery. The on-call engineer has been paged.

No change-manager approval was needed since v2.3.0 had previously been healthy in production.
